stances_toward.note: Two stages. 2024: Spain gave asylum to the opposition candidate Edmundo Gonzalez (Sept 2024) and Sanchez received him. After the US captured Maduro (3 Jan 2026) Madrid pressed Delcy Rodriguez's government to free Spanish prisoners, then in Feb 2026 asked the EU to lift her individual sanctions and invited her to the Ibero-American summit in Madrid (4-5 Nov 2026), reading the invitation as protocol. Partner by necessity (prisoners, a large Venezuelan diaspora, Spanish firms), trend warming; the stance depends on Washington's line. Bond - kin (language, diaspora). Confidence C: no source uses 'partner'.

stances_toward.note: No posture of its own, but the Kingdom's islands are Venezuela's immediate neighbours: the Netherlands kept out of the US build-up (Aug 2025) and of the 3 Jan 2026 operation that seized Maduro, said it was 'shocked' but 'did not shed tears', refused the use of Curaçao and keeps Dutch equipment on notice to move in the Caribbean; the military intelligence service (April 2026) described the US build-up as seen by Caracas as an intervention threat. The Dutch general staff fears the islands could be read in Caracas as part of the American offensive. Neutral because the Kingdom deliberately takes no side. Bond - none.
